rejectionGroups.reason: These product-only athletic or fleece basics lack reliable adult fit and movement proof and add generic technical repetition rather than a distinct modern styling role.
These dark quarter-zip, compression and crew-neck tops are narrow, generic or muscle-tight and recreate the skinny-top problem.
The distressed semi-transparent wide-scoop knit reads dated and fragile rather than clean Zara-led menswear.
These deep-scoop, stringer, V-neck and transparent tanks are bodybuilding-led, too revealing, tight or excessively long for the versatile modern matrix.
The plain long scoop-hem tank remains generic after all five colors were inspected, and only the black version provides on-body fit proof.
The low-buttoned black henley is overly long, narrow through the body and styled with excessive chest exposure; the lighter colors do not fix the silhouette.
These paint-splatter, camouflage, washed-denim and flower-patch cargo shorts are long, novelty-led, pocket-heavy or insufficiently proven.
These drawstring, denim and lightweight trousers are uncontrolled wide-leg, balloon, harem or puddled silhouettes and recreate the baggy-bottom failure.
These logoed or striped track trousers are wide, ankle-bunched and sportswear-novelty led rather than clean and versatile.

qaSummary: 40 identities and all 216 recorded color images rendered and loaded with zero broken files.
4 accepted with one exact color and variant selected each: light-green textured henley, khaki openwork knit tank, moss technical hiking trouser and army-green ribbed resort trouser.
36 rejected after the base pass and close inspection of all 21 variants across five borderline identities.
Every selected identity, variant and image has zero collision with every prior accepted or conditional item.
Most of the batch failed for compression or bodybuilding tops, generic dark knits, novelty cargo shorts, and uncontrolled wide or puddled bottoms.
